stem: The dialogue between Teresa and her mother after the tryout indicates that her mother —

options.label: A
options.text: believes that Teresa can make the Olympic team if she practices enough

options.label: B
options.text: knows that taking Teresa to the tryouts was a waste of time

options.label: C
options.text: thinks it was necessary to trick Teresa into taking long-jump practice seriously

options.label: D
options.text: wants Teresa to be honest with herself about her skill as a long jumper
